task.question: Who was the first male player to appear in six FIFA World Cups?
task.evidence: Argentine forward and captain Lionel Messi becomes the first male player to appear in six FIFA World Cups

answer:
Perfect! I found the answer.

FINAL: Lionel Messi was the first male player to appear in six FIFA World Cups, achieving this feat at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
